Players Committee card image of [[Temmin 'Snap' Wexley]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Imperials and bounty hunters deploy +1 here. Once per game, if a battle droid was just lost from same location, may steal it into hand.”

The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
